meeting_location: Champlain Room, 110 Laurier Avenue West, and by electronic participation

agenda_items.description:
Notices and meeting information are attached to the agenda and minutes, including: availability of simultaneous interpretation and accessibility accommodations; in camera meeting procedures; information items not subject to discussion; personal information disclaimer for correspondents and public speakers; notices regarding minutes; and hybrid participation details.
Accessible formats and communication supports are available, upon request.
Except where otherwise indicated, reports requiring Council consideration will be presented to Council on Wednesday, October 25, 2023 in Transit Commission Report 8.
The deadline to register by phone to speak, or submit written comments or visual presentations is 4 pm on Wednesday, October 11, 2023, and the deadline to register to speak by email is 8:30 am on Thursday, October 12, 2023.

sub_agendas_items.title: OC Transpo Update – Rail, Bus, and Para Transpo
sub_agendas_items.minutes:
Renée Amilcar, General Manager, Transit Services Department, Olivia McGuinty, Program Manager, Transit Employee Management Support, Raouia Howarth, Manager, Transit Technology and Innovation, Paul Treboutat, Chief Safety Officer, and Troy Charter, Director, Transit Service Delivery and Rail Operations, provided a verbal update and answered questions from the Commission.  A copy of their slide presentation is filed with the Office of the City Clerk.
James Greer, Director, Transit Bus Operations and Maintenance, and Matthew Wolstenholme, Manager, Service Planning also answered questions from Commission.
Sally Thomas and Patrick Shepherd spoke before the Commission on this item. There were no written submissions on this item.

sub_agendas_items.title: LRT Disruption – Root Cause Review
sub_agendas_items.minutes:
Renée Amilcar, General Manager, Transit Services Department, and Richard Holder, Director, Engineering Services presented an overview of the report and answered questions from the Commission.
The following stakeholders also provided a presentation to Commission and/or answered questions:
A copy of the slide presentations are filed with the Office of the City Clerk.
There were no public submissions on this item.

motions.motion_text:
Report recommendation(s)
That the Transit Commission receive this report for information.
